condition.notes: CAP-3 unoccupied-room reference. No human subject; subject_id SUBJ-NONE is a placeholder, not a person. Same sensor placement as the CAP-2/CAP-3 occupied sessions with the operator out of the room. distance_cm=0 records that no target distance existed; distance_cm_raw was null on all 2400 records. Producer reported PRESENCE_NOT_DETECTED and human_detected_stable=false on all 2400 records, and breath_phase was exactly 0.0 with a single distinct value. This session exists to supply device-side evidence for the presence-gating hazard reported by the model track in M-N7: all 8 canonical windows were ACCEPTED by M-N4 with MAD=0 and mad_collapsed=true, i.e. zero tensors. M-N4 does not reject unoccupied input; only a presence gate can. The producer signal needed for that gate is unambiguous here. boot_id is DERIVED, not emitted by the firmware: sessions sharing a boot show a monotonically increasing ts_monotonic_ms, and a backwards jump marks a new boot. This session belongs to BOOT-20260818-B. condition_intent records operator intent only; M-N10 sets intent_is_not_label=true, so it must never be mapped to a class. These three fields were added for M-N10 session_identity_required; whether M-N10 expects boot_id per RECORD rather than per SESSION is an open question with the model track, and this manifest takes the per-session reading. GEOMETRY MEASURED POST-SESSION, PARTIALLY INVALIDATED. On 2026-08-18, after all four sessions were recorded, the operator tape-measured the bench and in the same pass re-set the sensor tilt to 90 deg. Consequences, field by field: (a) sensor_height_cm is corrected from 100 to 75. The earlier 100 was an eyeball estimate; 75 cm is a tape measurement from the floor to the antenna face. The adjustment changed tilt only, not the desk or the mount, so 75 cm is taken to hold for the capture as well. (b) sensor_angle_deg REMAINS 100 (operator convention: angle from the desk surface, 90 = perpendicular). The bench now sits at 90 deg, but that is the post-session state and MUST NOT be read as this session's geometry. Any future session at 90 deg is not comparable to these four on angle. (c) distance_cm stays device-derived. A 50 cm tape reading was taken, but only after the tilt change, so it is recorded here rather than substituted. It is consistent with capture: distance_cm_raw is quantized to 5.74 cm bins and the observed 51.66 bin spans roughly 48.8-54.5 cm, which contains 50 cm. The capture-time tilt is therefore known only as the operator's ~100 deg estimate, and that uncertainty cannot now be reduced for these four sessions.
